“Feeling stuck in not a failure” - Yang Mun

#mindfulness #wellnessjourney #wellness #healthybodyhealthymind
transcript: Feeling stuck is not a failure. It is a signal. It often means you have stopped growing. When most people feel stuck, they panic. They think something is wrong with their life. They call it an existential crisis and try to burn everything down. But for most human beings, feeling unstuck does not come from destroying the present. It comes from reconnecting with growth, having something in the future that gently pulls you forward, learning a new skill, taking a class, changing a small routine, letting the body and mind experience something new, learning anything touches a deep human need. It reminds you that life is still moving through you. From that quiet sense of movement, from that small return of power, clarity begins to form. And only then can you see clearly what truly needs to change and what simply needs time and growth. This is exactly why the 30-day healing journey exists. Not to fix you, but to gently restore movement one day at a time. It's in the link in my bio.
